dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply concave spline fitting on the trailing edge, characterized by a sharp posterior curvature initiated approximately one-third of the way down from the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a narrow pixel radius at the highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep anterior margin contour, measured at approximately 70 degrees relative to the horizontal body axis, with a subtle convex spline.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Highly elongated profile where the vertical pixel height is approximately 1.8 times the maximum visible horizontal base width.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple irregular notches and jagged tissue loss along the lower half of the trailing edge. Scattered white punctate marks or depigmentation spots are visible across the lateral surface of the fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Notably slender and tapered distal half of the fin, resulting in a distinctively hook-like silhouette.
